textos.A divisão sobre o filme está na qualidad: The division over the film is in the quality of the script: most of those who do not recommend it point to weaknesses in the writing and poorly handled subplots, while most of those who recommend it value the construction of the dialogue and highlight Christoph Waltz's work on screen.
textos.Várias reviews reclamam que o sotaque e: Several reviews complain that Brad Pitt's accent and acting sound exaggerated and not very believable, even disrupting immersion in serious scenes.
textos.Tom misto entre comédia e drama/paródia: Mixed tone between comedy and drama/parody
textos.O grupo critica a alternância entre humo: The group criticizes the alternation between parodic humor and war themes, saying the tone becomes disjointed and that the jokes sound childish against the context portrayed.
textos.Uso da Segunda Guerra como entreteniment: Use of World War II as entertainment/fantasy revenge
textos.As reviews apontam que tratar o conflito: The reviews point out that treating the conflict as stylized fantasy and revenge hollows out the historical weight and sounds disrespectful toward the period portrayed.
textos.Várias pessoas descrevem a experiência c: Several people describe the experience as dragging, with long, drawn-out scenes that make it hard to finish the film.
textos.O grupo considera o roteiro simplista, c: The group considers the script simplistic, with abandoned arcs and character decisions that are not very believable or are predictable.
textos.Elogio isolado à atuação de Christoph Wa: Isolated praise for Christoph Waltz's performance
textos.Mesmo entre as críticas duras, muitas re: Even among the harsh criticisms, many reviews acknowledge that Christoph Waltz's performance is the high point and the main reason to keep watching.
textos.Vários espectadores consideram a perform: Several viewers consider the performance of the actor who plays the Nazi hunter the film's great standout, with his imposing presence and impressive switching of languages.
textos.Tom cômico e caricato em contraste com m: Comic, caricatured tone in contrast with serious moments
textos.Algumas reviews medianas apontam que o f: Some middling reviews point out that the film swings between high-quality dramatic sequences and slapstick moments, which makes for an uneven experience.
textos.Este grupo reclama que o meio do filme s: This group complains that the middle of the film drags, with long dialogue that adds no tension, making the experience tiring.
textos.Parte das reviews critica a abordagem co: A portion of the reviews criticize the approach as a revenge fantasy that oversimplifies World War II and exalts the US unrealistically.
textos.Alguns espectadores sentem que os Bastar: Some viewers feel that the Basterds and other characters have little screen time and depth, making the film less engaging.
textos.Há quem aprecie a violência exagerada co: Some enjoy the exaggerated violence as the director's trademark, while others consider it gratuitous or immature.
textos.Christoph Waltz é amplamente elogiado po: Christoph Waltz is widely praised for his performance as Hans Landa, described as terrifyingly good and able to dominate the screen in every scene.
textos.A habilidade de Tarantino em criar tensã: Tarantino's skill in creating tension through dialogue and prolonged scenes is highlighted, with mentions of the opening scene and the bar sequence as examples of masterful suspense.
textos.Muitas reviews elogiam a direção de Tara: Many reviews praise Tarantino's direction, his unique style, the sharp writing and the audacity of rewriting historical events.
textos.O roteiro é enaltecido por sua inteligên: The script is extolled for its intelligence, with striking dialogue and a narrative structure that holds attention, although some find the film too long.
textos.O elenco é muito elogiado, com destaque: The cast is highly praised, especially Brad Pitt, Eli Roth and the character Shosanna, as well as the chemistry among the actors.
textos.A violência estilizada e a fantasia de v: The stylized violence and the revenge fantasy are seen as cathartic and satisfying, providing a sense of poetic justice.

textos.Lançado em 2009 sob a direção de Quentin: Released in 2009 under the direction of Quentin Tarantino, Inglourious Basterds is a war drama and thriller set in occupied France during World War II. The premise follows a group of American Jewish soldiers known for spreading terror among the troops of the Third Reich, while a young Jewish refugee plots her own revenge in her cinema during a screening that will gather the top of the Nazi party.
textos.A experiência se estrutura a partir de c: The experience is structured around long scenes with detailed dialogue that build continuous suspense, blending dramatic passages with caricatured moments and bursts of stylized violence. It is a narrative conducted as historical fantasy, whose cadence extends across its one hundred and fifty-two minutes of running time.
textos.Na grande maioria das notas (~92%), a ma: In the vast majority of ratings (~92%), most extol Christoph Waltz's performance as Hans Landa, a good portion emphasize the control in building tension and suspense, and a significant share celebrate Quentin Tarantino's signature in the direction. The different reception profiles debate the same central topics of the work, diverging on the verdict about whether these devices work on screen.
textos.Nessa perspectiva, que aparece numa fraç: From this perspective, which appears in a minimal fraction of the ratings (~6%), several still consider Christoph Waltz's performance the strongest point, although some point to an uncomfortable mismatch between the comic tone and the more serious segments, while a smaller slice laments the uneven pace and the sense of excessive length.
textos.Para quem se situa numa fração ainda men: For those in an even smaller fraction of the ratings (~1%), many direct reservations at Brad Pitt's acting and accent, a portion criticize the swing between drama and parodic comedy, and a portion of them reject the use of World War II as fantasy-revenge entertainment.
